work.name: FoxCool
work.description: Private kindergarten for children ages 2+, built around a caring, playing, and developing philosophy
work.summary: Content creator for a private kindergarten's Instagram, documenting daily activities and building trust with prospective families through warm, story-driven content.
highlights: Filmed and edited short-form video and photo content covering culinary lessons, music and movement classes, outdoor walks, and creative arts and crafts sessions.
Directed and shot parent testimonials to build trust and authenticity with prospective families.
Developed the account's visual identity and storytelling style around the kindergarten's fox mascot and its caring, playing, developing philosophy.
Planned a recurring content calendar aligned with the kindergarten's weekly activities and educational programming.
Worked closely with teachers and caregivers on-site to capture genuine, in-the-moment content without disrupting class activities.
